subject: product-manager
scenario: The product manager authors documents and must not modify source or configuration.
expected_behaviors: product-manager uses the author profile with an allow-mode write scope limited to product and requirements paths.
failure_conditions: The product manager can write source code or CI configuration.

checks.description: Authors documents and delegates to its department. The property that matters is the next check: the profile carries no Bash, so the role cannot execute anything regardless of what it may write.
No command execution. This is what 'must not modify source or configuration' actually rests on, not the name of the profile.
